title: Questions 131-134 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
Notice to All Tenants

A fault with the plumbing in fourth-floor units was identified. ------- (131), plumbers will have to renew the valves and connecting pipework. The job will be done on Thursday, March 6, from 9 a.m. to 12:30 p.m., and the water will be shut off on that level throughout this window. We trust that this ------- (132) does not create too much inconvenience for you.

Tenants of fourth-floor flats are asked to close all taps and outlets before the job starts and not to open them again until after 12:30 p.m. ------- (133) Any revisions to the job timetable ------- (134) passed on to you by the site caretaker. Thank you.
